title: Newsroom sign-in is Google-redirect only: "oauth param not configured" on a backend with Google OAuth disabled; add email+password sign-in
description: Newsroom LOGIN calls signInWithRedirect Google only (components/reader-auth-control.tsx). Backends without Google OAuth fail with "oauth param not configured". When OAuth is not configured, present email+password sign-in, sign-up with confirmation code, sign-out; keep Google when configured; staging gate must accept email+password sessions.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closed as not needed: Ryan requires Google sign-in only (decision 2026-10-06). The real fix was PPY-cee38d / Pilobol.us#48 (Google on, auth config from the scaffold). The agent working this was stopped; no code landed.
